headline: This law changes the federal charter of the National FFA Organization by adding a purpose statement and removing the Secretary of Education as board chair.
what_it_does: The National FFA Organization, formerly known as Future Farmers of America, is a group chartered by Congress. This law amends that charter in two ways. It adds a stated purpose for the group to be an integral component of agricultural education. It also removes the Secretary of Education as the chair of the National FFA Board of Directors.

who_it_affects.group: National FFA Organization board of directors
who_it_affects.how: The Secretary of Education no longer serves as the board's chair, so the board sets its own leadership under its charter.

who_it_affects.group: Students and teachers in agricultural education programs
who_it_affects.how: The organization's federal charter now lists its role in agricultural education as a core purpose, though the summary does not describe any day-to-day change.
